purpose: Operational parameters that are NOT frozen strategy rules. live/config.pstar.json is deliberately untouched here: its digest is bound into the sealed target contract (config_checksum), so adding an operational knob to it would invalidate the 2026-11-23 entry batch. Everything in this file is an operator/monitoring parameter and is read by live/pause_switch.py and skills/pstar-risk-check/scripts/risk_check.py.
provenance: prompt 08 part A item 1, user decision of 2026-11-21 (cloud executes the final exit and risk reductions, Slack PAUSE/RESUME is the only human control)

pause_switch.why_this_mechanism: The prompt asked, in order: (1) a moomoo watchlist flag, (2) Qoder shared workspace memory / project wiki, (3) a file in a git repo both sides pull. Measured on 2026-11-22: (1) works - quote_modify_user_security accepts ADD/DEL on an existing CUSTOM group and quote_user_security reads it back, and both the local Desktop chat and a cloud session reach the same moomoo account through the same MCP, so the state is shared and survives between cloud sessions; its ceiling is that it carries only which symbols are in the group (no timestamps, no metadata) and the MCP cannot create a group or store a non-ticker string. (2) is documented in notes/handbook-notes.md but is unverifiable from this repository: no cloud session has written a memory a local chat later read, so it cannot be claimed as the switch. (3) is impossible as delivered: `git remote -v` is empty, so there is nothing for either side to pull. Conclusion: option 1, with the day ring below supplying the only expiry the channel can carry, and time/source recorded in the journal row and the Slack thread rather than in the flag.
pause_switch.group_provisioning: the MCP has no group-creation tool (quote_modify_user_security accepts only ADD, DEL, MOVE_OUT and fails with `group_name not found` for an unknown group), so the user creates the empty PSTAR-PAUSE watchlist once in the moomoo app before the first write; until then every read reports `unknown` and entries stay blocked
pause_switch.sentinel_disjointness: no sentinel may appear in etf_universe, etf_sleeve, spy_route, discretionary_symbols or the sealed target weights: a flag symbol is never tradable, so a book that contains one would make the switch ambiguous
pause_switch.verified: 2026-11-22: all 16 codes resolve on quote_market_snapshot with sec_status NORMAL and trust_valid true, and none is in the P* book

risk_check.warn_note: The WARN line sits below the frozen ALERT/KILL rules in live/config.pstar.json (trim 39% of initial assets, margin 95%, drawdown -8%): a warning posts to Slack and changes no order, so it is an operational knob and lives here rather than in the sealed config. position_count_warn_fraction is the fraction of max_positions above which the position count itself is a warning.

peak_equity.fallback_basis: max(initial_equity, highest equity in the previous end-of-day report) when no peak file exists; the script says which basis it used in every report

slack.control_source: the user's own Slack account only, as the whole message, never quoted and never from another person
